## Description

Please include a summary of the change, problem fixed, and relevant motivation.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Security enhancement / hardening

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's coding standards and style guidelines.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly.
- [ ] `python -m pip check` passes with no broken dependencies.
- [ ] `python -m pytest tests/ -v` passes with all tests green.
- [ ] No secrets, live tokens, or private employee records are included.
